build_dqn_atari_network: build a DQN Atari network with a duelling MLP head for a given number of actions
build_r2d2_atari_network: build an R2D2 recurrent Atari network with an optional custom RNN core and duelling head
build_impala_atari_network: build an IMPALA recurrent Atari network with LSTM core and policy-value head
build_deep_impala_atari_network: build a Deep IMPALA Atari network using a ResNet torso and policy-value head
build_atari_torso: build a convolutional Atari torso network with three conv layers and a flatten output
